hero.name: Jorge Bonifaz
hero.role: I build systems that organize and grow your business
hero.tagline: I help businesses leave behind notebooks, spreadsheets and chaos. I build custom systems that save time, prevent mistakes and stop customers from slipping away.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: A bit of my story
about.p1: I don't just build "websites". I build systems that solve a business's day-to-day: scheduling appointments, recording sales, tracking inventory and keeping all the information in one place, accessible from any device.
about.p2: I have already shipped real systems to production for a clinic, a rotisserie restaurant and a multi-services company. I know how to turn a business problem into a simple tool that people actually use every day.

solutions.title: Solutions for your business
solutions.subtitle: Is your business still running on notebooks, spreadsheets and WhatsApp? I've already solved that chaos across different industries. Yours could be next.
solutions.cta: Is your business like this? Let's talk
solutions.health_for: Clinics, dental offices, veterinaries, medical centers
solutions.health_desc: Appointments, records and patients organized and one click away. No schedule clashes or lost files.
solutions.food_desc: Orders, sales and cash under control. Fewer kitchen mistakes and reports to know what sells best.
solutions.services_desc: Customers, services and inventory in one place, tracking every job.
